articles.full_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange alert for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Uttarakhand and Chhattisgarh today. The IMD forecast heavy rainfall over Haryana, Chandigarh, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh and parts of North East India today.
The Met Department also predicted Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds over Jammu-Kashmir, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Mahe, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, Lakshadweep and Andaman and Nicobar Islands for the day. In Delhi, the met department estimated cloudy sky with the possibility of light rainfall during the day. According to the Weather Agency, the maximum temperature will be around 33 to 35 degrees Celsius in Delhi while the minimum temperature will hover around 23 to 25 degrees Celsius today.

articles.full_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued an orange alert for Uttarakhand and Chhattisgarh, warning of heavy to very heavy rainfall on Sunday, August 9. Several other regions, including Kerala, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana and Tamil Nadu, have been placed under a yellow alert for heavy rain.
The weather warning for Sunday also includes thunderstorms, lightning and gusty winds in several parts of the country. Strong surface winds are also likely over parts of Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Lakshadweep and Tamil Nadu. Meanwhile, coastal areas along the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal are expected to experience squally weather.
Very heavy rainfall in Uttarakhand, Chhattisgarh
Heavy to very heavy rainfall is likely at isolated places over Uttarakhand and Chhattisgarh on August 9. The warning also indicates isolated heavy rainfall over several other parts of the country, including Assam, Meghalaya, Bihar, coastal Karnataka, east Rajasthan, east Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Kerala, Mahe, Lakshadweep, Madhya Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Odisha, Punjab and Sikkim.
Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds of 40-50 kmph are likely at isolated places over Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Mahe, Lakshadweep, North Interior Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal.
Gusty winds of 30-40 kmph, accompanied by thunderstorm and lightning are also likely over Bihar, coastal Karnataka, east Rajasthan, Gangetic West Bengal, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh, Gilgit, Baltistan, Muzaffarabad, Jharkhand, Madhya Pradesh, Odisha, south interior Karnataka and Vidarbha.
Lightning and thunderstorm activity is also expected over Assam, Meghalaya, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat Region, madhya Maharashtra, Marathwada, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Uttarakhand and west Rajasthan.
Strong surface winds in south India
Strong surface winds are likely over parts of Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe, Lakshadweep, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal. The warning is also in place for Karnataka, Kerala, Lakshadweep and Tamil Nadu on August 9, with strong surface winds expected in these areas.
Rainfall is expected to continue across parts of northwest India over the coming days. Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Gilgit, Baltistan, Muzaffarabad, Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand are likely to receive rainfall during the period.
Parts of central India are also likely to receive widespread rainfall. West Madhya Pradesh is expected to see widespread rainfall during August 9-12, while east Madhya Pradesh is likely to receive widespread rainfall during August 9-11. Heavy rainfall is likely over west Madhya Pradesh during August 9-10 and east Madhya Pradesh on August 9 and 10. Chhattisgarh may also see heavy rainfall during August 10-14, with very heavy rainfall likely on August 9.
Rainfall is expected across Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Gangetic West Bengal, Jharkhand, Odisha and Sub-Himalayan West Bengal and Sikkim during August 9-14. In the Northeast, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura are expected to see widespread rainfall during August 9-14.
Coastal Karnataka, Kerala, Mahe and Lakshadweep are likely to receive fairly widespread to widespread rainfall till August 14. Thunderstorms with gusty winds of 40-50 kmph are likely over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal on August 9 and 10, while Kerala, Lakshadweep and North Interior Karnataka may see similar conditions on August 9.
